Theme

Conversation, family & daily routines

hurry up! phrase

also hurry, quick, chop chop, get a move on

classical

Traupman 101

Mātūrā! Mātūrāte!

Other words

  • Properā! Properāte! — hurry!

    imperative of properō · also used · classical · Plaut. Ps. 330; Mart. 13.55.1

  • Ōcius! — quick! faster!

    comparative adverb (“more swiftly”), with an imperative · also used · classical · Plaut. Curc. 276

Examples

  • Properā, quid stās?

    Hurry up, why are you standing there?Plaut. Ps. 330

  • heus Phaedrōme, exī, exī, exī, inquam, ōcius.

    Hey, Phaedromus, come out, out, out, I say, quick!Plaut. Curc. 276

See also at once, coming!, come on!.
